description: Pavement Widths is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of London. A line dataset representing estimated pavement (footway) width across the City of London. Each line contains a numeric value indicating the width of the pavement at that location. Width values are derived from pavement polygon geometries or road‑edge‑to‑building‑line measurements and are assigned to a uniform grid for spatial analysis. Coverage: City of London. The portal files it under the publisher City of London. It offers 2 resource(s) in WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-03-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
